name: Avant-garde
description: A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on December 1st, 2020.
This paint could have been unlocked at Tier 7 of the December 2020 Challenge A.
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.
This paint is a favorite among tankers who want to stand out from the crowd, making their own way in a world where all the other battle machines stick to the status quo.
